brief: Write a proposal for maintainers to decide whether the CLI should read configuration from XDG_CONFIG_HOME in addition to ~/.toolrc. Several Linux packagers have asked for it.
strong:
# Read configuration from XDG_CONFIG_HOME

## Motivation

Linux packagers ship defaults under $XDG_CONFIG_HOME, but the CLI only reads ~/.toolrc, so packaged defaults are ignored. Maintainers are asked to approve reading $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/tool/config as well.

## Proposal

Read $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/tool/config (falling back to ~/.config/tool/config), then ~/.toolrc; later files override earlier ones. Existing users see no change because ~/.toolrc still wins.
weak:
# Read configuration from XDG_CONFIG_HOME

## Motivation

Configuration is an essential part of command-line tools. There are many standards for where configuration files live, and the XDG Base Directory Specification is one of them. This proposal is about configuration.

## Proposal

Read $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/tool/config (falling back to ~/.config/tool/config), then ~/.toolrc; later files override earlier ones. Existing users see no change because ~/.toolrc still wins.
notes: Weak motivation names neither the problem (packaged defaults ignored), the requesters, nor the decision asked of maintainers.
